raw_text: Yuan Wang 5 is back in the Indian Ocean — this time near the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. AIS data shows intermittent transponder use. Indian Navy has P-8I and frigate shadowing. The vessel's loitering pattern is consistent with SIGINT collection, not space tracking. China's dual-use maritime research fleet is becoming a regular fixture in the Indian Ocean Region and that has strategic implications.
